name: Bright Data
description: Web data / scraping platform offering proxy networks, Web Unlocker, SERP API, Web Scraper APIs and dataset marketplace via REST.
access_notes: Self-serve signup; a default API key is auto-created on account creation and managed in Account settings (admin role needed to mint new keys). Every new account includes a free tier of 5,000 requests/month (shared pool, runs on Web Unlocker API); paid usage-based plans beyond that.
mcp_notes: Official vendor Web MCP: hosted remote endpoint https://mcp.brightdata.com/mcp?token=API_TOKEN plus self-hosted @brightdata/mcp npm package (github.com/brightdata/brightdata-mcp). Composio toolkit BRIGHTDATA exists with 10 tools (API_KEY auth).
uncertainty_notes: auth 'custom' = Native proxy access via proxy-protocol username/password credentials (documented alternative to REST API key). Webhook/callback delivery for scraper results not verified this pass, left null.

evidence.note: Two methods: API key as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' for REST, or Native proxy username/password; default API key auto-created on account creation, admins manage keys in Account settings.
REST API at api.brightdata.com; API key is 'full compliant with REST API', proxy user/pass for native 3rd-party tool access.
Official Bright Data MCP server (remote managed or self-hosted); every new account includes 5,000 free requests per month.
Official vendor repo for @brightdata/mcp; hosted endpoint mcp.brightdata.com/mcp with API token; 5,000 free credits/month, no card needed.
Composio Brightdata toolkit page: 10 tools (Web Unlocker, SERP Search, Trigger Site Crawl, datasets etc.), connected via user's Bright Data API key.
Single RESTful endpoint https://api.brightdata.com/request with Bearer API key; shows scraping/unlocker workflow.
